i.norm: Verifies that querying the PROLEPTIC_MONTH field range on a 13-month AccountingChronology returns a non-null ValueRange. The chronology is configured to: - end each year on a Saturday - anchor to the last week of January - divide the year into 13 equal months of 4 weeks - place the leap week in month 4 - use a year offset of 4 Because the division is THIRTEEN_EVEN_MONTHS_OF_4_WEEKS, the chronology should return the 13-month proleptic-month range (PROLEPTIC_MONTH_RANGE_13).
true = year ends in the last week of the anchor month
